summary: Delegates return to the state section and stand where the chairs had been.
realLife: Moran reported that the Mississippi chairs were gone when Freedom Democrats came back the next evening, and that they stood in the space left behind.
gates: The state seating section has been cleared since the last session.
inGame: needs: the previous floor plan, observed furniture change and separate credentials roll.

turns.what: The group sits for the closing business.
turns.pulledBy: Ushers bring chairs back before adjournment.
turns.writesBack: The seating change leaves voting credentials a separate question.

turns.what: The delegation asks where the state section will be.
turns.pulledBy: The session moves to a new hall.
turns.writesBack: The replacement floor plan records its assigned space.
